scripts.build: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/api build && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/web build
scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/domain build && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/manifest build && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/markdown-parser build && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/azure-devops build && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/storage build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:packages && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/web typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/domain test && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/manifest test && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/markdown-parser test && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/azure-devops test && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/storage test && pnpm --filter @manual-test-manager/api test
